title: Specialist, Product Analyst- Quality
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share the best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
As a Specialist, Product Analyst – Quality, you will be responsible for driving solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the different QMS tools with specific alignment to the Quality business processes. Essential skills include a strong technical as well as business background, proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum), and excellent organizational abilities.
  
This role is positioned within the company , will have advanced experience in the life sciences industry, specifically Quality Management Systems and technology landscapes; specifically, Veeva Vault Quality; will have knowledge of GxP and will play a critical role during the solution design to satisfy business needs and assuring adoptability to future system scalability.
  
  
**PrimarySkills:**  
VEEVA Configurations ,SDLC Specialist;Scrum Master ,
  
AGILE ways of working ; JIRA and Devops ; Business Management, Business Processes, Business Process Management (BPM),
  
Business Process Modeling, Computer Science, Customer Experience Management, Digital Transformation, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Management System Development, Multi-Management, Product Management, Product Strategies.
  
  
Project Management,Requirements Management, Software Product Management, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, System Designs, Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Technical Projects.
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**  
Veeva Config specialist, GXP
  
  
**What would you do:**  

* Apply a structured approach to discover, document, and manage business process, user and stakeholder needs, including opportunity statements, use cases, insights, and requirements.
* Gather insight into user journey, behavior, motivation, and pain points. Expose unarticulated problems and unmet needs.
* Document business process, business, and user needs in the form of problem statements to make up the backlog. Facilitate the “how” with the Development team.
* Gain expertise in the business area.
* Manage business analysis per agreed priority backlog items in JIRA.
* Participating in impact assessment activities, reviewing proposed changes and ensuring impact is understood.
* Deliver product enhancements through agreed backlog process to ensure Quality solutions evolve to meet business needs.
* Ensure Quality solutions remain compliant as a Validated Solution through verification testing, documentation, and validation efforts.
* Provide overall leadership, guidance, and management of all aspects of a given solution, including requirements gathering, enhancements delivery plan, and implementation.
* Initiate projects including defining a scope/charter, identifying stakeholders, and establishing governance.
* Act as a bridge between Business SMEs, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders. Communicate delivery status, solution health, risks, and issues to all parties involved and ensure that everyone is aligned and informed.
* Conduct product status meetings and present updates to stakeholders and senior management. Evaluate delivery performance and implement continuous improvement practices.
* Understand the technical aspects as well as business process impacts to make informed decisions, provide guidance, and communicate effectively with the development team. This includes having a deep understanding of the QMS business processes, technology stack, architecture, and potential technical challenges.
* Work closely with the Product Owner to prioritize and refine the product backlog, ensuring that the team focuses on delivering the most valuable features.
* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that could impact project success.

**What should you have:**  

* Minimum Level of Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, and Science OR in a related field. The job requires a solid academic background on how Information Technology supports the delivery of business objectives.
* Preferred Level of Education: Veeva Certifications (Veeva Vault/Vault Quality Suite/ QMS). The role holder has completed the Certified Vault Training and is up to date.
* 3 years of experience in technical project management, with a strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Understanding of Quality Management System Capabilities (Audit/Inspection management, CAPA management, Deviations management, Complaint management).
* Experience in solution delivery with GMP systems.
* Experience with architecture, integration, interfaces, portals, and/or analytics.
* Understanding of Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) processes.
* Knowledge and experience with QMS relevant tools like Veeva Vault Quality, TrackWise.
* Proven experience in leading complex technical projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong technical background with knowledge of software development, systems integration, or related areas.
* Excellent organizational, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt to changing priorities

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.
  
  
Who we are
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing , bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
What we look for
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
Asset Management, Asset Management, Backlog Management, Backlog Prioritization, Business Acumen, Business Decisions, Business Informatics, Commercial Software, Delivery Management, Impact Analysis, Management System Development, Product Management, Project Charters, Quality Management System (QMS) Compliance, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Requirements Management, Scrum, Solution Deployment, Solutions Delivery, Solutions Development, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Status Reporting, Strategic Planning, System Designs, Systems Development {+ 4 more}

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Project Role :** Scrum Master  
**Project Role Description :** Acts as an enabler for the effective functioning of a software development team using Agile methodologies. Coaches and mentors the Scrum Team(s), removing barriers to successful implementation and enabling a continued focus on the task at hand. Facilitates scrum and agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Identifies and reports progress via appropriate metrics.
  
**Must have skills :** ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
In the role of Scrum Master, a typical day involves enabling the smooth operation of a software development team by fostering an environment that supports Agile practices. This includes guiding the team through various Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. The Scrum Master actively works to identify and remove any obstacles that may hinder the team's progress, ensuring that members remain focused on their objectives. Additionally, the role requires monitoring and communicating the team's progress through relevant metrics, while continuously supporting and mentoring the team to enhance their performance and collaboration.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between team members and stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.
* Promote continuous improvement by encouraging feedback and adapting processes to enhance team efficiency and delivery.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and fostering a collaborative learning environment.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
* Experience in facilitating Agile ceremonies and applying Agile methodologies effectively.
* Strong skills in team collaboration and conflict resolution to maintain a productive work environment.
* Ability to track and report project progress using appropriate metrics and tools.
* Competence in identifying and removing impediments to ensure continuous workflow.
* Excellent communication and mentoring skills to support team development and performance.

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
* This position is based at our Hyderabad office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Specialist IS Business Systems Analyst - R&D PPM
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-253538 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

As a Business Systems Analyst within our global Commercialization and R&D PPM Technology team, this role will help evolve R&D PPM (Project and Program Management) capabilities. Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!

In this vital role, you will apply systems, data, and business-process expertise to translate business needs into clear product and system requirements. You will define epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, use cases, data requirements, and test scenarios that enable delivery teams to estimate, plan, and deliver with confidence.

You will support Project and Portfolio Management (PPM), including Planisware-enabled planning, technology assessments, AI enablement, roadmap development, and data-management activities, using structured, consulting-style problem solving to help stakeholders make informed technology and investment decisions.

The ideal candidate will work closely with R&D PPM subject matter experts, process owners, data owners, Product Owners, developers, data engineers, architects, UX designers, QA teams, portfolio leaders, and external partners to ensure applications, data, analytics, portfolio, and AI-enabled solutions meet business, functional, quality, and compliance expectations.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and System Architects to manage business analysis activities, ensuring alignment with business and product goals
* Understand customer needs to shape business processes and product requirements
* Lead structured technology assessments covering business fit, technical fit, architecture alignment, integration and data impacts, security and compliance, cost, risk, scalability, vendor considerations, and implementation readiness; translate findings into decision-ready options, recommendations, business cases, and phased roadmaps.
* Identify and shape AI-enablement opportunities by defining use cases, value hypotheses, data-readiness needs, workflow impacts, responsible-AI considerations, adoption plans, human oversight, and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and maintain integrated product, technology, and capability roadmaps aligned with R&D PPM strategy, business priorities, investment decisions, dependencies, and delivery milestones; support PI planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, release planning, and delivery sequencing.
* Support Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) processes in Planisware, including demand intake, portfolio planning, prioritization, scenario analysis, resource and capacity planning, dependency management, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting.
* Partner with portfolio and product stakeholders to improve PPM governance, Planisware data quality, reporting consistency, decision support, and adoption.
* Ensure functional and non-functional requirements are documented, traceable, and prioritized in product and release backlogs.
* Clarify requirements, resolve gaps, and facilitate alignment when SMEs or stakeholders have conflicting needs.
* Define and advance data-management practices for ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, quality, lineage, access, lifecycle, master and reference data, and governance.
* Work with data engineers, architects, analytics teams, and data owners to ensure data products meet business needs and are usable, trusted, scalable, and compliant.
* Collaborate with Business SMEs and Product Management to prioritize release scopes and refine the Product backlog
* Facilitate the breakdown of Epics into Features and Sprint-Sized User Stories and participate in backlog reviews with the product team
* Clearly express features in User Stories/requirements so all team members and stakeholders understand how they fit into the product backlog
* Ensure Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done are well-defined and understood
* Stay focused on software development to ensure it meets requirements, providing proactive feedback to stakeholders
* Develop and deliver product demonstrations, assessment readouts, roadmap updates, business cases, and recommendations for business, portfolio, SME, and technical stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, assumptions, decisions, processes, assessments, roadmaps, user stories, and changes.
* Use Planisware, Jira, Confluence, and related Agile and PPM tools to manage portfolio information, requirements, backlogs, defects, decisions, and delivery activities.
* Work within Agile and Scaled Agile environments to deliver incremental business value.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve portfolio management, requirements, testing, data management, and delivery processes undefined

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree and 8-13 years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Data, or a related field.

**Functional Skills:**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Extensive experience in business systems analysis, product analysis, or requirements engineering.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) processes, including portfolio planning, prioritization, roadmapping, resource and capacity planning, scenario analysis, and reporting.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with business and technical SMEs to elicit, clarify, validate, and document complex requirements.
* Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder-management, and executive-communication skills.
* Consulting-style skills in structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, option evaluation, recommendation development, executive-ready communication, and influencing without authority.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology assessments and translating complex findings into options, trade-offs, recommendations, business cases, and implementation roadmaps.
* Ability to translate specialized R&D, process, portfolio, data, and technology knowledge into clear functional, data, and technical requirements.
* Experience writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process maps.
* Experience developing and supporting product, technology, and capability roadmaps, including PI planning, prioritization, dependency management, delivery sequencing, backlog refinement, and user journeys.
* Experience defining data, analytics, reporting, KPI, dashboard, and portfolio-management requirements.
* Understanding of data management and governance, including data ownership, stewardship, metadata, mapping, validation, business rules, reconciliation, lineage, data quality, access, and lifecycle management.
* Experience shaping AI-enabled use cases from opportunity identification through value assessment, data readiness, requirements definition, adoption planning, responsible-use considerations, and outcome measurement.

* Experience supporting functional testing, regression testing, defect management, and UAT.
* Experience using Planisware, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable portfolio and product-delivery tools.

* Strong ability to communicate complex technical, portfolio, AI, and data concepts in clear business terms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual, and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to quickly learn and apply new business processes, technologies, and tools.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-253537 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.

This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.

The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.
* Experience working across digital product, software engineering, data, analytics, and/or AI product teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change from project-based technology delivery toward persistent product teams and outcome-oriented delivery.

title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:

Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

 We are seeking an energetic and experienced Scrum Master with 3 to 6 years of experience to lead our Agile teams.  Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure team alignment and momentum.
   

  

 Scale with SAFe: Guide the team through SAFe practices, aligning delivery with Program Increment (PI) objectives and cross\-team dependencies.
   

  

 Track \& Report Metrics: Leverage JIRA to manage backlogs, track workflows, and generate actionable reports (e.g., velocity, burndown/burnup charts, cumulative flow) for stakeholders.
   

  

 Remove Impediments: Proactively identify, track, and resolve blockers to protect the team's focus and velocity.
   

  

 Coach \& Mentor: Foster a culture of psychological safety, continuous improvement, and self\-organization within the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience working as a Scrum Master in software development environments.
   

  

 Certification: Mandatory SAFe Certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master \- SSM or SAFe Agilist \- SA).
   

  

 Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of Agile frameworks, Scrum values, Kanban principles, and scaling patterns.
   

  

 Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on expertise with JIRA (creating custom dashboards, filters, epics, and advanced reporting).
   

  

 Communication \& Collaboration: Exceptional stakeholder management, conflict\-resolution, and transparent reporting skills.

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
